P.name: Signature of the Visionary
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Hwei's''' damaging {{tip|abilities}} mark enemies hit for 4 seconds. Subsequent damaging abilities against marked targets consume the mark to create an explosion beneath them, dealing {{as|{{pplevel|40 to 285}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} to enemies in the area after a {{fd|0.85}}-second delay.

Q.name: Subject: Disaster
Q.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Hwei''' enters a disastrous mood, gaining access to its abilities as well as ''{{ai|Wash Brush|Hwei}}''. He will exit the mood upon casting any of them.

Q.name: Devastating Fire
Q.description: {{sbc|Active - QQ:}} '''Hwei''' slings a fireball in the target direction that explodes upon colliding with the first enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 250 against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 170}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|3 to 7}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}

Q.name: Severing Bolt
Q.description: {{sbc|Active - QW:}} '''Hwei''' calls upon a lightning bolt to strike at the target location after {{tt|1 second|From start of cast time}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within the area.
Q.description2: If ''Severing Bolt'' hits only one enemy or {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} enemies, it deals {{ccs|increased|magic}} damage based on the {{tt|{{as|target's '''missing''' health}}|See notes}}. This '''bonus''' damage is capped at 300 against monsters.
Q.description3: ''Severing Bolt'' deals 50% damage to {{tip|minions}} and non-epic {{tip|monsters}}.

Q.name: Molten Fissure
Q.description: {{sbc|Active - QE:}} '''Hwei''' marks a blazing path in the target direction. After {{tt|{{fd|0.6}} seconds|From start of cast time}}, the path erupts into volcanic explosions every {{tt|{{fd|0.2}} seconds|Estimated}} from the point of cast, for a total of 7 explosions. Each explosion creates a shockwave that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
Q.description2: Each explosion also leaves a lava fissure in its wake. A fissure lasts for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to enemies within the area and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 35%. Enemies may be damaged by multiple fissures at once.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|50/10 to 200/10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60/10}}% AP)}}|Total Fissure Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 200}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
Q.description3: ''Molten Fissure's'' damage is reduced to 60% against {{tip|minions}} and increased to 135% against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.description4: ''Molten Fissure's {{tip|slow}} stacks multiplicatively with the slows applied by {{ai|Grim Visage|Hwei}}, {{ai|Crushing Maw|Hwei}}, and {{ai|Spiraling Despair|Hwei}}.''

W.name: Subject: Serenity
W.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Hwei''' enters a serene mood, gaining access to its abilities as well as ''{{ai|Wash Brush|Hwei}}''. He will exit the mood upon casting any of them.

W.name: Fleeting Current
W.description: {{sbc|Active - WQ:}} '''Hwei''' forms a current of water in the target direction, creating a path for a duration that grants him and allied {{tip|champions}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{tip|ghosting}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds, with the bonus refreshing every {{fd|0.125}} seconds while they remain in the area.
W.leveling:
{{st|Path Duration|{{ap|4 to 6}} seconds}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|30 to 40}}% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}}}}
W.description2: '''''Hwei''' can move during Fleeting Current's cast time.''

W.name: Pool of Reflection
W.description: {{sbc|Active - WW:}} '''Hwei''' summons a pool of water at the target location, creating a protective zone for 3 seconds that grants him and allied {{tip|champions}} a {{tip|shield}} at the start of the cast time and for {{fd|0.5}} seconds while within the area. The shield refreshes and increases in strength by an amount every {{rutngt|0.25}} over the duration while they remain in the area.
W.leveling:
{{st|Initial Shield Strength|{{ap|50 to 130}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Shield per Tick|{{ap|50/6 to 130/6|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30/6|round=2}}% AP)}}|Total Maximum Shield|{{ap|50*2 to 130*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*2}}% AP)}}}}
W.description2: ''Pool of Reflection's'' shield strength is reduced to 85% for allies.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Ally Initial Shield|{{ap|50*0.85 to 130*0.85}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*0.85}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Ally Bonus Shield per Tick|{{ap|50*0.85/6 to 130*0.85/6|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*0.85/6|round=2}}% AP)}}|Ally Total Maximum Shield|{{ap|50*2*0.85 to 130*2*0.85}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*2*0.85}}% AP)}}}}

W.name: Stirring Lights
W.description: {{sbc|Active - WE:}} '''Hwei''' surrounds himself in swirling flares that empower his next 3 [[basic attacks]] or [[champion ability|ability]] hits within 9 seconds to each deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and restore {{sti|{{as|mana}}}}.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 60}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|20*3 to 60*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15*3}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Mana Restore|{{ap|135/3 to 195/3}}|Total Mana Restore|{{ap|135 to 195}}}}
W.description2: ''Stirring Lights' '' '''bonus''' damage is reduced to 50% against {{tip|minions}} or {{tip|monsters}} if applied by his area of effect abilities.

E.name: Subject: Torment
E.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Hwei''' enters a tumultuous mood, gaining access to its abilities as well as ''{{ai|Wash Brush|Hwei}}''. He will exit the mood upon casting any of them.

E.name: Grim Visage
E.description: {{sbc|Active - EQ:}} '''Hwei''' launches a terrifying grin in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, {{tip|knockdown|knocks them down}}, and {{tip|fear|fears}} them for a duration, as well as {{tip|slow|slows}} them by {{pp|type=distance from '''Hwei'''|70;78;86;94;99|0;300;600;900;1100|key=%|changedisplay=true|formula=70% + 1% for every 38 units the target is away from Hwei at the time of being hit}} for the same duration.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 230}} {{as|(+ 65% AP)}}}}
{{st|Disable Duration|{{ap|1 to 1.5}} seconds}}
E.description2: ''Grim Visage's {{tip|slow}} stacks multiplicatively with the slows applied by {{ai|Molten Fissure|Hwei}}, {{ai|Crushing Maw|Hwei}}, and {{ai|Spiraling Despair|Hwei}}.''

E.name: Gaze of the Abyss
E.description: {{sbc|Active - EW:}} '''Hwei''' tosses an eyeball to the target location. Upon arrival, it expands over {{fd|0.2}} seconds into a dark gaze that lasts 3 seconds and grants {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|area|Can see into brush and terrain}}. After {{fd|0.7}} seconds of being placed, the eye locks onto the nearest visible enemy champion or otherwise remains there until an enemy champion is in range. Once locked on, the eye launches itself at the target after a {{fd|0.3}}-second delay and collides with the first enemy hit to deal {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|true sight|reveal}} them for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, and {{tip|root}} them for a duration.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 230}} {{as|(+ 65% AP)}}}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|1.2 to 2}} seconds}}

E.name: Crushing Maw
E.description: {{sbc|Active - EE:}} '''Hwei''' conjures a jaw at the target location that snaps after {{tt|{{fd|0.6}} seconds|From start of cast time}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies in the area and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by an amount that decays over {{fd|1.25}} seconds. Enemies that are not standing at the center when the jaw snaps are {{tip|airborne|pulled}} there.
E.description2: ''Crushing Maw's {{tip|slow}} stacks multiplicatively with the slows applied by {{ai|Molten Fissure|Hwei}}, {{ai|Grim Visage|Hwei}}, and {{ai|Spiraling Despair|Hwei}}.''

R.name: Spiraling Despair
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Hwei''' launches a globule of pure despair in the target direction that collides with the first enemy {{tip|champion}} hit, afflicting them with an [[aura]] that grows over 3 seconds, {{tip|true sight|reveals}} the target, and grants {{tip|sight}} within its radius. Enemies within are both dealt {{as|magic damage}} and applied a {{tip|stack}} of ''Despair'' every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
R.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|10/4 to 30/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5/4}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|10*3 to 30*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*3}}% AP)}}}}
R.description2: {{sbc|Despair:}} For each stack, the target is {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 10% for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, stacking up to 12 times.
R.description3: At the end of the duration or when the target dies, the aura explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within and remove all ''Despair'' stacks from affected enemies.
R.leveling3: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 450}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}|Maximum Total Damage|{{ap|200+10*3 to 450+30*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80+5*3}}% AP)}}}}
R.description4:
''Spiraling Despair can only be cast if '''Hwei''' has not entered a mood.
Spiraling Despair's {{tip|slow}} stacks multiplicatively with the slows applied by {{ai|Molten Fissure|Hwei}}, {{ai|Grim Visage|Hwei}}, and {{ai|Crushing Maw|Hwei}}.''

R.name: Wash Brush
R.description: {{sbc|Toggle - QR, WR, ER:}} '''Hwei''' exits his current ''mood'' without incurring its ability cost or cooldown, toggling it off.
R.description2: ''Wash Brush can only be cast if '''Hwei''' has entered a mood, and can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''
